title: [DEV] Target in AAPSClient not aligned with AAPS using DynISF sensitivity target adjustment
body:
AAPS / AAPSClient 3.2.0.1-dev
Build: ddc643b83a-2023.10.31

Nightscout-versjon: 15.0.2

Tested https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/2992 with DynISF and options for adjusting target if sensitivity or resistance is detected enabled.

If I understood the change right, target in AAPSClient should change to show same value as AAPS when target is adjusted by autosens or dynISF-"autosens".
